checkpoints.notes: This dossier synthesizes accepted artifacts; it does not regenerate them.

crates_io_identity.cross_check: crates.io packages matrix-sdk/matrix-sdk-ui 0.18.0 checksums recorded in P0.3a provenance; source behavior and manifests verified against git tag matrix-sdk-0.18.0 at commit 1c44fb66214667c6d00acaf72ab592493653708b.

tag_commit_verification.notes: Cloning the annotated tag matrix-sdk-0.18.0 detaches HEAD at commit 1c44fb66214667c6d00acaf72ab592493653708b. Absolute temporary clone paths are intentionally omitted.

limitations: Absolute temporary clone paths omitted from committed evidence.
crates.io package identity is not a substitute for pin-source inspection; both are required and were performed in P0.3a/P0.3c.
No live Synapse, semantic integration, or UI acceptance is claimed in this dossier.

section_5_evidence_items: E1: stable or consciously accepted experimental API at pinned source
E2: minimal repository-owned probe compiles against locked dependency
E3: unit/integration test demonstrates required semantics
E4: live Synapse test demonstrates network behavior when server-dependent
E5: UI acceptance demonstrates end-to-end product behavior
section_5_decision_rule.separation: API-shape / feature-graph intermediate statuses from P0.3b/P0.3c remain evidence. Final Section 5 states never equate compile-only presence with product parity.
mapping: confirmed-stable / confirmed-experimental: only if every applicable E1–E5 item is present and cited. P0.3d has no E3/E4/E5, so these states are not used for any row.
typed-sdk-request-required: only when accepted P0.3c proves public Ruma request through SDK Client::send as the product residual path.
upstream-change-required: only when accepted evidence states no viable public route at this pin.
not-required: only with explicit accepted product-scope proof; not used without that proof.

blocked: compile-proven or experimental-shaped capabilities that still lack required product gates (E3/E4/E5 and/or feature risk gate / runtime store proof / experimental acceptance). Name exact missing gates.
